local.description: A middle-aged man from the rural American South with a thick, slow Arkansas drawl. Gravelly, nasal, a little slow on the uptake, comic and deadpan. Close, dry studio recording.

dispatch.description: An older woman, a tired small-town Southern police dispatcher with a dry smoker's rasp and a flat Arkansas accent. Bored, clipped, deadpan. Close, dry studio recording.

barker.description: A fast-talking Southern carnival barker, a man in his fifties with a brassy, theatrical, wheedling voice and a strong country accent. Loud and showy. Close, dry studio recording.

maw.description: A towering elderly alien grandmother from a 1950s B-movie flying saucer: a big, warbling, rubbery, nasal old woman's voice with a thick rural Southern drawl, bossy, doting and comic. Close, dry studio recording.

sheriff.description: A B-movie alien posing as a small-town Southern sheriff: a rubbery, warbling, slightly electronic voice with a slow, smug county-lawman drawl, officious and comic. Close, dry studio recording.

jerry.description: A huge, booming Southern country man in his sixties, a self-made big shot who talks like a football coach at halftime: loud, gravelly, swaggering, red-faced. Close, dry studio recording.

foreman.description: A hulking lumber-mill foreman in his fifties, a deep, rough, shouting voice worn ragged by sawdust and saw noise, Southern, bossy and mean. Close, dry studio recording.

baron.description: A pompous old Southern moonshine baron, a wheezy, plummy, self-important voice with a slow genteel drawl that turns into a bellow. Close, dry studio recording.

swamp_king.description: A fat, loud bayou swamp boss, a big wet booming Cajun-country voice, cocky and rowdy, used to shouting over an airboat engine. Close, dry studio recording.

boggs.description: A redneck demolition derby champion in his forties, a hoarse, cocky, hollering voice with a thick country accent, wild and grinning. Close, dry studio recording.

hick.description: A young rowdy Southern redneck man in his twenties, loud, twangy, cocky and none too bright, with a thick rural Arkansas accent. Close, dry studio recording.

deputy.description: A gruff, self-important small-town Southern sheriff's deputy in his forties with a nasal drawl, barking orders like he owns the county. Close, dry studio recording.

coot.description: A cranky old Southern hillbilly man in his seventies, wheezy and half toothless, cackling and grumbling, with a thick Ozark accent. Close, dry studio recording.

grey.description: A small B-movie grey alien speaking in a high, buzzing, nasal monotone with a slight electronic warble, comically officious and fussy. Close, dry studio recording.

mundell.description: A wiry, wild-eyed Southern country man in his thirties, the hero of a rowdy shoot-'em-up: a twangy, raspy, quick-talking hillbilly voice, cocky, gleeful and a little unhinged, with a thick Arkansas accent. Close, dry studio recording.
